verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API for creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, with full parity to the dashboard. The official MCP server is built on this API, and the CLI also offers raw API access. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common docs paths, but that does not contradict the API's existence; it only leaves the machine-readable spec unconfirmed. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This is the API you use to programmatically manage your Flagsmith projects. Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API
